lyrics:
[Intro: warm chords, a child laughing far off]

[Beat Enters: loose rolling house drums, soft bass]

[Section A: bright singing synth melody]

[Section B: melody doubled, wordless voices behind]
(Ooh, ooh)

[Break: chords alone, a splash, a child laughing]

[Spoken: an older woman, warm, half to herself]
You look like her
When you laugh, you look just like her

[Drop: full groove, melody an octave higher, handclaps]
(Ooh, ooh)

[Outro: chords, the melody once on piano, quiet]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, D major. Bright, warm and gently emotional.

VOICE: No sung verses. Distant wordless female voices as texture. One line spoken once in the break by an older woman with a warm, unhurried voice.

INSTRUMENTS: A bright, singing lead synth with a little glide, warm analogue chords, loose, rolling house drums with a shaker, a soft round bass, handclaps, a felt piano that plays the melody at the end, a child's laugh and a splash.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, chords. 0:16 Beat enters. 0:32 Section A, melody. 1:04 Section B. 1:36 Break. 1:46 Spoken line. 1:58 Drop, melody up an octave. 2:44 Outro, melody on piano, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2020 melodic UK house: warm, colourful and soft-edged, melody in front, drums loose and light.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The spoken line at 1:46, then the melody returning an octave higher at 1:58.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 2 p.m. The closing track of the set: bright, wordless and a little moving, for the last hour.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Content, startled, tender, glad.
